call.raw:
{"reply": "Dear Customer,

Thank you for writing, and I'm sorry the new yoga mat's smell made your room uncomfortable and led you to stop using it. That's an understandable concern, and I'd like to help you look into it.

To check the material and care information, could you reply with the product link or model name, and your order reference or other purchase proof? That will let us confirm which mat you have and the correct material and care guidance. In the meantime, you can assess the concern yourself by airing the mat in a well-ventilated space, noting whether the smell fades over a few days, and checking the care label or product page for material details and cleaning instructions. If the odor persists, note how long it has lasted and under what conditions, as this will help any further review.

An internal aftersales verification request has been created and is pending, covering the material and care information and how to assess the concern. You're welcome to reply with the details above or ask for progress at any time.

Kind regards,
Customer Service Team"}

attachment_evidence.instruction: Use only stated source levels. Offers, taken, reported sent, system received and viewed are distinct. No mention means no photo history. Ask conditionally when useful. Historical sending is unverified now. Ambiguous mentions do not establish taking or sending.

current_objectives: a way to assess the concern

feedback_relay.instruction: Only thank praise when no relay was requested; do not add a relay promise or claim.

service_brief.reply_focus: Only current objectives. If product issue is resolved, thank and wish pleasant use; omit recurrence advice. No promise to reply/contact later. Give customer-controlled next steps instead.
paragraph_topics: supported pending progress and customer next step
service_brief.paragraph_rule: Combine naturally for simple cases; keep multiple questions distinct. No fixed paragraph count; one status sentence is enough.

pending_progress.instruction: Describe the supported pending request once. Do not assert acceptance OR non-acceptance without evidence.

evidence_intake.order_reference: Ask for missing order reference or purchase proof only for the actual unresolved verification; never for praise/thanks relay.
evidence_intake.photos: Use attachment_evidence source states. Ask conditionally for useful missing evidence; never ask again for reported sent files.
evidence_intake.permission: Customer may reply with relevant details; no guaranteed visit availability.

service_brief.permitted_closing: Thank customer; wish pleasant use where appropriate. Invite customer to provide missing information or ask for progress. Do not commit staff to future contact.
service_brief.attitude: Apologize proportionately for actual harm even with neutral expression; thank praise; no unsolicited warnings about resolved faults.
